items.scope: Vulnerabilities in vendor products discovered by BLSOPS, or related parties, while performing vulnerability research or security assessments, unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
All Temporal Technologies software.
Synology issues only.
Lexmark products only.
All Mattermost issues, and vulnerabilities discovered by Mattermost that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All NortonLifeLock product issues only.
Vulnerabilities discovered by CyberArk Labs that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All SAP products.
Vulnerability assignment related to FSI’s vulnerability coordination role in the South Korea financial sector that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Synaptics issues only.
Gridware software, services, and infrastructure issues, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to Gridware researchers that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All NLnet Labs projects.
Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, Logstash, X-Pack, and Elastic Cloud Enterprise products only.
Eaton issues only.
Microchip Technology products only.

All BeyondTrust products, including PasswordSafe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, Privilege Management for Windows/Mac, Privilege Management for Unix/Linux, Identity Security Insights, Active Directory (AD) Bridge, and Total PASM.
All EnterpriseDB products and vulnerabilities identified in open source libraries used by EnterpriseDB products unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Supermicro branded products, managed system, or software projects.
PaperCut MF, PaperCut NG, PaperCut Hive, PaperCut Pocket, PaperCut Mobility Print, QRdoc, PaperCut Views, PaperCut Multiverse, https://www.papercut.com, and all other PaperCut products and services.
All ONEKEY products and vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by ONEKEY that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All GE Vernova products.
Zephyr project components, and vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Concrete CMS Core versions 8.5 and above.
Genetec products and solutions only.
Hanwha Vision (formerly Samsung Techwin and Hanwha Techwin) products and solutions only, including end-of-life (EOL).

All F5 products and services, commercial and open source, which have not yet reached End of Technical Support (EoTS). All legacy acquisition products and brands including, but not limited to, NGINX, Shape Security, Volterra, and Threat Stack. F5 does not issue CVEs for products which are no longer supported.
Yandex issues only.
All vulnerabilities on software products that our company provides, including KNIME Analytics Platform, KNIME Server, and KNIME Hub.
Citrix issues only.
Pegasystems products only.
Pure Storage products only.
All Esri products only, including ArcGIS.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
StrongDM issues only.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.
Vulnerabilities in supported Ivanti products and infrastructure, excluding third-party components, and meeting severity thresholds defined in Ivanti’s Disclosure Policy found here.
Zoom and Keybase issues only.
Vulnerabilities related to products of Mitsubishi Electric Group.
Vulnerabilities discovered in the services and applications of the MeetMe and DuoxMe products that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
ASR products only.
All ServiceNow products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by ServiceNow that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Armis products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Armis that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Western Digital products including WD, SanDisk, SanDisk Professional, G-Technology, and HGST only.
SolarWinds products only.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Qualys products and vulnerabilities discovered by Qualys that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in any Google Cloud developed product and not under the scope of another CNA.
All Acronis products, including Acronis Cyber Protect, Acronis Cyber Protect Home Office, Acronis DeviceLock DLP, and Acronis Snap Deploy.
Sophos issues only.

Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
